verdict.rationale: Crossplane is driven entirely through declarative Kubernetes-style APIs. It extends Kubernetes with managed resources (e.g., an RDS instance MR), and XRDs define schemas for composite resources. Its docs explicitly position these as machine-readable APIs that "humans, automation, and AI systems can safely act on," governed by Kubernetes RBAC. Missing for 10: an explicit API reference document in the evidence, documentation of how an AI agent would authenticate and call these APIs, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven use.
